theatre.positionBasis: The upload metadata gives an exterior geographic camera location. The university places the theatre on the Old Court side. Exact interior registration, ellipse ratio and rise remain estimates unless an architectural section gives them.

exteriorConstruction.historicStreetFront: Retain a continuous ground-floor portico and the masonry street wall. The University’s historic facade study dates the last major portico work to the 1942 expansion.
exteriorConstruction.oldCourtForm: A double columned loggia with a stone balustrade and continuous entablatures. The original CC0 photo records wall planes and reliefs.
